aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:850.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Dynamics 365 Developer is responsible for the architecture, design, development, and administration of AEG's Power Apps and Dynamics platform. This role is a critical resource focused on building, maintaining and supporting custom application versions across multiple business units. The role will be an integral member of the AEG Global Technology team and liaise directly with stakeholders from various business areas to understand and support their application needs. The role will also work closely with the Infrastructure and Operations team to ensure that all standards and security requirements are met and delivered. Essential Functions Administration, development and support of Microsoft Platforms Apps across various AEG entities. Provide support and administration of third party solutions. Maintenance of custom configurations within the Power Platform environment and Dynamics Platform. Development of integrations of data and functionality using the Power Platform (Power Automate and Power Apps) Documenting and defining user requirements with product stakeholders, including flow charts, layouts and diagrams Establishes best practice for support of and knowledge sharing of the functionality of the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environment. Support Azure Web App Servers Work with the AEG Data Engineering and BI teams to ensure data integrity across the applications and datasets when using Dataverse. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) Computer Science or related technical area 2-4 years Experience with Dynamics 365, Office 365 and Microsoft Power Platform preferred Experience working with Azure Functions and Logic Apps and Azure Web Services Experience of working with various systems integrations, including APIs, stream data sources Experience working with application managements lifecycle tools/source control, Power Apps Experience of Application Development, using C#, .Net and SQL Experience with Azure SQL Database Experience with Scripting languages including HTML5, CSS, Node.js, and Javascript Experience with Dataverse is preferred Experience with Typescript preferred Experience with Power Apps Pipeline preferred Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to interface with all levels of the organization Possesses a balance of an analytical personality coupled with strong collaborative, communication, written and executive presentation skills Demonstrated ability to lead projects Organized, diligently follows up on open tasks Competency in Analytical Problem Solving, Product & Technology Expertise, Project Management, Strategic Insights Strong understanding of Power Platform modules with functional knowledge of the entire product suite Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator (MCSA) Dynamics 365 related certifications Power Platforms Fundamentals PL-900 Microsoft Dynamic 365 Fundamentals (CRM) MB-910 Pay Scale: $125,000.00 - $145,000.00 Bonus: Th

jobgether-jobgether:lever:23cb9e97-579f-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:23cb9e97-579f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Croatia. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3e75444e-ba3d-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:3e75444e-ba3d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Romania. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships. Pr

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6c0d59a1-f6f8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MEP Design Engineer based in France. As an MEP Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the technical development of a major AI data center project with significant power and infrastructure requirements. You’ll take responsibility for designing and reviewing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems supporting critical infrastructure. Your work will directly influence reliability, energy efficiency, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance across the facility. You’ll collaborate with technology, IT infrastructure, suppliers, and engineering partners to integrate complex systems into a cohesive design. The role covers everything from electrical distribution and cooling to fire protection, ventilation, and building management systems. You’ll also contribute to technical specifications, tender processes, vendor evaluations, and the ongoing development of the Basis of Design. This is an opportunity to work on advanced infrastructure in a technically demanding, international, and fully remote environment. Develop and review electrical distribution systems , including medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, diesel generators, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Design and review cooling and ventilation systems , including chillers, dry coolers, water towers, and liquid cooling solutions where applicable. Coordinate modular facility architecture and ensure effective integration with mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure. Develop gas fire suppression, ventilation, and OT/IT integration systems, including BMS and DCIM solutions. Review technical and design documentation provided by suppliers, contractors, and engineering partners, identifying risks, inconsistencies, and potential design gaps. Ensure MEP solutions comply with applicable regulatory, safety, reliability, and energy-efficiency requirements. Prepare, maintain, and update the Basis of Design and associated technical specifications. Participate in tender processes and evaluate technical proposals from vendors supplying generators, UPS systems, chillers, switchgear, and other critical equipment. Coordinate closely with IT Infrastructure teams to align power and cooling requirements with IT deployment needs. Support technical coordination throughout the project lifecycle and contribute to resolving design and integration challenges. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in MEP design for critical infrastructure or heavy-industry facilities, such as data centers, industrial plants, energy facilities, telecommunications infrastructure, or comparable environments. Demonstrated experience designing cooling and ventilation systems ; strong conventional HVAC experience is sufficient. Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems used in critical infrastructure environments. Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit , and relevant engineering calculation or design software. Ability to review multidisciplinary technical documentation and identify engineering risks, discrepancies, and integration issues. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical design solutions. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with suppliers, engineering partners, IT teams, and other stakeholders. English proficiency sufficient to work effectively with international teams and prepare or review technical project documentation. Experience with Tier III/IV facilities is an advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems or high-density computing environments is a plus. Familiarity with EU or Polish electrical, building, and fire safety regulations is desirable. southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:8be23f3a.title: Staff Software Engineer
southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:8be23f3a.description: About Pulley Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays. We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore. WHAT YOU'LL DO In this role, you will build the product that gets stuff built. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, and end-users to accelerate our product development. As a staff-level software engineer at Pulley, you will: - Own problem areas, not just features—define the technical direction for a domain spanning multiple product surfaces, and carry it from ambiguity through architecture to shipped, iterated-on product - Turn unstructured permitting documents, city regulations, and jurisdiction workflows into fast, reliable product experiences, with AI at the core of how the product works - Build with AI agents as a daily practice—directing, reviewing, and shipping agent-driven work at high velocity while owning the quality bar - Make the technical bets that determine what Pulley can build next year, not just this quarter—and own the consequences of those bets in production - Multiply the engineers around you: set technical direction others build within, mentor senior engineers toward larger scope, and make the whole team faster through the systems, standards, and abstractions you create WHO YOU ARE - You thrive in ambiguity—you'd rather define the right problem than execute a spec, and you're energized rather than paralyzed when the path isn't laid out - You're product-minded: you care whether the thing you built actually solved the customer's problem, and you'll talk to users to find out - You have strong opinions about quality and velocity and don't treat them as a tradeoff — you look for the tools, abstractions, and processes that buy both - You default to ownership at organizational scale: when something is broken or missing—a system, a process, a gap between teams—your instinct is to fix it, and you don't need permission or a mandate to start NEED TO HAVE - 8+ years of software engineering experience - Track record of owning a significant technical domain end-to-end: from "this is somebody's problem" through architecture, delivery, and production ownership, including the unglamorous parts - Fluency in modern full-stack development—we use TypeScript, React, and Google Cloud; you don't need our exact stack, but you should be productive with something similar - Real experience building with AI coding agents and LLM-powered features—not just autocomplete; you've shipped work where agents did substantial implementation under your direction - Ability to architect durable systems while making pragmatic tradeoffs - Experience mentoring engineers or setting technical direction that other engineers built within - Based in the San Francisco Bay Area and willing to work in person 4 days a week NICE TO HAVES - Experience in construction tech, govtech, proptech, or another domain where the hard part is messy real-world documents and processes - Experience designing evals or otherwise making LLM-powered
